· 52-week position (7.4%) + Approaching historical low price range.

· RSI trajectory (54.3→41.8) — Entered oversold territory, confirming downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (87.7594→-148.7209) — Continued worsening, strengthening bearish momentum.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $62,458.29) — Approaching lower band, potential for increased volatility.

· Swing resistance ($64,443.71) — First resistance zone for short-term bounces.
· 5-day high ($65,321.84)/low ($62,690.77), 20-day high ($65,658.34)/low ($62,226.58) — Attempting to raise lows within a sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.04x) — Moderate confidence in current price action.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — Maintaining a wait-and-see stance due to RSI entering oversold and ADX being trendless; confirmation needed on breaking the first resistance ($64,443.71) during a bounce.
